# Product

## Register

product

## Users

Developers, platform engineers, and SREs operating webhook integrations, event delivery, and self-hosted infrastructure.

## Product Purpose

Payload Bay is a self-hosted platform for receiving, verifying, storing, routing, and reliably delivering webhooks and events. Its mission is to give every event a safe landing place without coupling providers directly to application availability.

## Brand Personality

Technically precise, calm, transparent, realistic, and free of artificial enterprise language or hype.

## Anti-References

None specified.

## Accessibility Needs

Maintain clear information hierarchy, keyboard-accessible interactions, readable copy, and sufficient contrast across product-critical flows.
